basic_details.short_information: Indian Rare Earths (IREL) Director (Human Resources) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of Indian Rare Earths (IREL). A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the IREL Director (Human Resources) Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 40 years Age Relaxation: Internal: 2 years residual service as on DOV; Others: 3 years residual service as on DOV. Age of superannuation 60 years.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IREL Director (Human Resources) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IREL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IREL Director Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IREL Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IREL Director Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IREL Director Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate with good academic record from recognized University/Institute. Post Graduate Diploma or Degree in Personnel Management/Human Resource Management or MBA/PGDM/PGPM desirable.

content_sections.heading: IREL Director Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 40 years Age Relaxation: Internal: 2 years residual service as on DOV; Others: 3 years residual service as on DOV. Age of superannuation 60 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IREL Director (Human Resources) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IREL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IREL Director (Human Resources) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IREL Director (Human Resources) post is 17th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Director (Human Resources) post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Director (Human Resources) post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Director (Human Resources) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Director (Human Resources) post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 160000 to Rs. 290000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates with a good academic record and preferably have a Post Graduate Diploma/Degree in Personnel Management/HRM or an MBA/PGDM/PGPM.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Director (Human Resources) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website for IREL recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IREL recruitment, where you can find more details and apply, is https://pesb.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a full-time job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a full-time employment opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 84/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxations are provided. Internal candidates get 2 years of residual service, and others get 3 years of residual service as on the Date of Vacancy (DOV). The age of superannuation is 60 years.
